Which section had the highest average units?
solution:
**Given:**

We must find the average height of Section A and Section B.

**Formula used:**

Average = Total height ÷ Total students

**Calculations:**

Section A total height ⇒ 1.50×5 + 1.65×9 + 1.52×11 + 1.55×14 + 1.78×6 + 1.77×7 + 1.70×4

⇒ 7.5 + 14.85 + 16.72 + 21.7 + 10.68 + 12.39 + 6.8 = 90.64

Total students A ⇒ 56

⇒ Average A = 90.64 ÷ 56 = 1.618

 

Section B total height ⇒ 1.50×4 + 1.65×8 + 1.52×13 + 1.55×10 + 1.78×7 + 1.77×5 + 1.70×3

⇒ 6 + 13.2 + 19.76 + 15.5 + 12.46 + 8.85 + 5.1 = 80.87

Total students B ⇒ 50

⇒ Average B = 80.87 ÷ 50 = 1.6174

**∴ Section A had the highest average height.**
